text:
Alex P: Heads up — Snowcap's marketplace PO (PO# SC-2026-0412) is still blocked in procurement. They signed commercial, but procurement is flagging the SOW + indemnity clause redlines. Can we escalate?

Maria D: Ugh — saw that. They're insisting on a vendor-friendly IP carveout and longer liability cap. Legal already pushed back.

Jordan S: We need this for their onboarding this week. Customer says they can't launch unless the PO clears. Any workaround like a temporary MSA?

Nisha L: We reviewed their redlines. Two non-starters: (1) IP assignment language removes our product protections, (2) indefinite liability exposure. I proposed the clause below as compromise: 
```
Vendor retains IP in pre-existing and platform tech. Customer gets a narrow license for marketplace listing and use. Liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months.
```
But procurement says they need more.

Tom R: From finance — we can sign off on a capped liability tied to the committed spend, but only if sales confirms expected ARR + an invoice schedule. Also need PO flow: do we accept their PO or require our standard invoice + ACH?

Alex P: Sales confirmed ARR = $420k first 12 months. We could accept PO but procurement wants contract language in their PO rather than a separate MSA. That slows legal.

Maria D: Snowcap is pushing marketplace listing to drive a co-marketing launch next Tue. Marketing is on standby. If legal can't finish, maybe accept a conditional PO with a go-live holdback clause?

Nisha L: Conditional PO is doable but risky. We can insert a go-live holdback: 20% of payment held until final agreement executed. Also add a short-term indemnity cap for the pilot period. Will draft and share in 30m.

Jordan S: That would work for them if procurement has a written holdback. I'll loop their procurement contact (cc: @procurement).

ProcureBot: PO SC-2026-0412 status changed to "Under Review" by Maria D at 2026-04-12 14:07 UTC.

Tom R: One more ask — finance needs the exact invoice schedule to clear accounting automation. Jordan, can you confirm milestone dates?

Jordan S: Yes — milestone 1 (marketplace listing) 2026-04-20 50%, milestone 2 (first 3 integrations) 2026-05-20 30%, final acceptance 2026-06-20 20%. I'll send a signed schedule to Maria + Tom.

Maria D: Received. Nisha, once you post the draft clause I can share with Snowcap procurement and request a quick legal-to-legal review. Can we aim to lock by EOD? :crossed_fingers:

Nisha L: Draft posted in thread and uploaded to the deal folder. Quick TL;DR: we keep core IP protections, add 20% holdback, and a 12-month liability cap. If they refuse, escalate to VP Legal.

Alex P: Thanks — I'll ping Snowcap procurement now and mark this as high priority. If we don't have a signed agreement + PO by EOD, escalate to Sales Ops and Partnerships leadership.

ProcureBot: Reminder — Outstanding documents: signed PO, SOW acceptance. Due by 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC.

Jordan S: On it. Sending their procurement the draft and invoice schedule now.

Maria D: Keeping thread updated. If anyone gets direct legal-to-legal reply, paste it here.

Nisha L: Will monitor. If they push more IP concessions I'll flag immediately.

Alex P: Appreciate everyone — this is the last blocker before the co-marketing launch. :rocket:
